title: Estée Lauder Companies strengthens Kilian Paris and Frédéric Malle leadership with Guillaume Gellusseau
summary: Guillaume Gellusseau has been named SVP and GM for two of Estée Lauder Companies’ fragrance brands, Kilian Paris and Parfums Frédéric Malle

extraction.key_fact: 에스티 로더 컴퍼니가 두 향수 브랜드의 총괄 책임자를 새로 임명했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Guillaume Gellusseau has been named SVP and GM for two of Estée Lauder Companies’ fragrance brands, Kilian Paris and Parfums Frédéric Malle
